requires: An M-VAVE FM-1 running stock V15 or official fm1_open firmware. If it runs stock V15, this page installs official Open first
Chrome or Edge on a computer, with MIDI and SysEx allowed
Anything you want to keep backed up. On official Open, M-VAVE's workbench backs up projects, samples and voices. Stock V15 has no project library for it to read

notes: Firmware 0.9.3 makes project names usable. On PROJECTS the place KNOB 3 changes is an orange block, an empty place is a dot, and the line says K2 MOVE K3 A-Z. 0.9.2 marked the place with brackets the screen's font cannot draw, so it showed nothing.

What another firmware left in the saving area, as stock V15 does, is now erased when PROJECTS opens with the pattern stopped, with no question. A sample bank is still never erased, and nothing is erased while a pattern plays.

0.9.2 runs on one unit, installed from stock V15 through both stages: start-up, sound, the keys and sequencer, MIDI clock over USB, saving, and GLOBAL's settings after a power-off, with FAULTS at 0. 0.9.3 has not run on a device: it is tested on the host and in the FM-1 emulator, including under the chip's alignment rule. Bluetooth, long runs and leaving for official firmware are untested.
If an FM-1 is restarting at the start-up screen: power on holding HOME until SAFE MODE shows, then connect the installer. This has not been tried on a device.
